mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 9.5% triggers bearish sentiment and reduced market confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises above 9.5% in the next month
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or t-test p > 0.05 showing no significant negative effect.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate and surge in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) amplifies accommodative monetary policy, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly higher than baseline (p > 0.05) despite the combined signal, or the interaction effect rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, sustained high quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) above 13,277.4 indicates robust demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 does not rise sufficiently to trigger the signal, or 60-day returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment (UNRATE) and rise in employment (PAYEMS) reflect strengthening labor market conditions, boosting investor confidence and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite the combined labor market signal, or interaction effect rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden increase in the federal funds rate above 2% signals monetary tightening, raising recession risks and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns not significantly negative (p > 0.05) despite the rate hike, or the signal is not active in the observed period.

mechanism_narrative: Rapid growth in monthly employment (PAYEMS) above previous levels indicates a strengthening labor market, fostering optimism and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite rising payrolls, or the effect is not statistically significant.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the supply index (INDPRO) above 95 signals robust production capacity, enhancing economic confidence and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite the supply index rising above 95, or the effect is not statistically significant.
